listing.name: Zeus: Master of Olympus (eZeus)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Original adventures supported; Windows beta package available. Limits: Original adventures supported upstream with acknowledged differences; English/Polish and base+Poseidon data required. Upstream platforms: Windows beta package; Linux build instructions and macOS ARM64/x86-64 build scripts documented. Selected Windows package CPU unknown in frozen evidence. Original data: Original Zeus plus Poseidon needed; English/Polish only; differences from original acknowledged. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
